short_description: Construction management at risk services for a new office building in Savannah.
project_scope: Adams II Office Building project in Savannah. The notice identifies a general building project with a total construction cost of 32,000,000 USD. No gross floor area, height, structural system, or other technical building characteristics are stated.
services: Construction Management at Risk (CMAR) services for the office building project; disciplines requested include Design Build/Developer and Construction/Project Management.
relevance_explanation:

- No indication of long spans, special structures, innovative materials, or architecturally demanding structural scope.
- Therefore strategically not relevant for sbp.
